description: depgraph settings at the scanned root, or of a directory below it (a package of a monorepo: its layers, forbidden, components, ignore and unused-code paths are relative to that directory). Every key is optional; unknown keys, rules, options and layer names are errors.

abstract.description: Layer -> layers whose types it may hold only as interfaces / abstract classes (imports stay allowed): a struct field or constructor parameter of an implementation is a concrete-dependency. Names must be defined in layers (or be default layers).

Layer -> layers whose types it may hold only as interfaces / abstract classes (imports stay allowed): a struct field or constructor parameter of an implementation is a concrete-dependency. Names must be defined in layers (or be default layers). Within one component directory.

forbidden.description: Layer -> layers it must not import, within one component directory. Names must be defined in layers (or be default layers).

layers.description: Layer name -> package patterns: path globs (path segments; ** any number of segments); ext:<name> for an external package and what is under it (ext:gorm.io/gorm, ext:net/http: the standard library too); ext:<pattern> with * / ? for third-party packages (ext:* is every one, never the standard library); !<pattern> leaves packages out ("!ext:github.com/google/uuid"). Package globs are relative to the component's directory. Replaces the default layers and their forbidden and abstract pairs.

components.description: Parts of a monorepo with layers of their own: directory (relative to this file) or a pattern over directories (packages/*: one component per directory, * and ? but no **) -> its layers and forbidden pairs, with package globs relative to that directory. The default layers are not applied inside a component; layers declared at the root apply everywhere. A directory's own .depgraph.yml does the same.

forbidden.description: Layer -> layers it must not import. Names must be defined in layers (or be default layers).

ignore.description: Package globs excluded from every rule (they are still scanned and shown in the UI).

layers.description: Layer name -> package patterns: path globs (path segments; ** any number of segments); ext:<name> for an external package and what is under it (ext:gorm.io/gorm, ext:net/http: the standard library too); ext:<pattern> with * / ? for third-party packages (ext:* is every one, never the standard library); !<pattern> leaves packages out ("!ext:github.com/google/uuid"). Replaces the default layers and their forbidden and abstract pairs.

project.description: Project key in the database (default: the directory name of the root; @<worktree> is added in a linked git worktree).

rules.description: Per rule: enabled, severity and the rule's options.

concrete-dependency.description: a struct / class holds an implementation of a layer it must use through an interface (abstract:)

duplicate-code.description: the same logic in several places, whatever the names

minTokens.description: Bodies with fewer syntax tokens are not compared.

similarity.description: Minimum Jaccard similarity of the bodies' fingerprints (1: the same shape).

duplicate-symbol.description: an exported function / class declared in several files

ignore.description: Symbol names never reported (replaces the defaults): an exact name, a prefix such as Test*, or a glob where * is any run of characters and ? one character.

god-package.description: a hub: imported by many packages and importing many

fanIn.description: Report a package imported by at least this many packages (and importing at least fanOut).

fanOut.description: Report only packages that also import at least this many packages of the repository: a widely used package that depends on nothing is stable, not a god package.

large-package.description: a package with more lines of code than its limit (maxLines for Go packages; layers: a limit per layer, for every language)

layers.description: Layer name (of the root's layers) -> the limit of each of its packages, in every language: an outer layer that should stay thin. The smallest limit of a package's layers applies, before maxLines.

maxLines.description: Report a Go package with more lines than this (test and generated files left out; 0: off). A directory of another language is a set of modules, not one namespace: only layers limits it.

layer-violation.description: a package imports a layer it must not import

module-cycle.description: import cycle between the modules of a monorepo (Go modules, npm packages, Python projects, Ruby gems / packwerk packs, components)

unreachable-file.description: a TS/JS/Python/Ruby file no entry point reaches

entries.description: Path globs of entry points depgraph cannot see (plugins loaded by name, files an external tool runs). Shared by unused-export, unreachable-file and unreachable-package.

ignore.description: Path globs (files and Go package directories) never reported, e.g. a library's public API. Shared by unused-export, unreachable-file and unreachable-package.

unreachable-package.description: a Go package no entry point reaches

entries.description: Path globs of entry points depgraph cannot see (plugins loaded by name, files an external tool runs). Shared by unused-export, unreachable-file and unreachable-package.

ignore.description: Path globs (files and Go package directories) never reported, e.g. a library's public API. Shared by unused-export, unreachable-file and unreachable-package.

unused-export.description: an exported declaration nothing in the project uses

entries.description: Path globs of entry points depgraph cannot see (plugins loaded by name, files an external tool runs). Shared by unused-export, unreachable-file and unreachable-package.

ignore.description: Path globs (files and Go package directories) never reported, e.g. a library's public API. Shared by unused-export, unreachable-file and unreachable-package.

store.description: How Neo4j is provided. Flags and environment variables take precedence.

containerCli.description: Container CLI of the container provider: docker, podman, nerdctl or a path (default: the first that answers).

persist.description: Keep the container provider's data in a named volume across runs.

provider.description: external: the Neo4j of --neo4j / $NEO4J_URI; container: depgraph runs one (default when no URI is set).
